start.text: The heavy glass lobby doors of the central Neo-Ministry Bank don't merely shatter when your hands touch the frames; they dissolve into thousands of sharp, microscopic needles of black crystal glass that rain down violently onto the waterlogged concrete pavement. As you take your first step outside, you realize the natural night sky has been completely swallowed by an artificial, suffocating dome of blinding red tactical spotlights slicing through the downpour from orbiting military platforms. A colossal legion of heavily armed Ministry Enforcers—tens of thousands of faceless soldiers encased in thick, sound-dampening matte-black ceramic armor—have entirely barricaded the three-mile boulevard with fortified personnel carriers, flashing high-voltage suppression fences, and humming automated rail-gun defense turrets. The air itself feels visibly warped, compressed by a deafening, localized anti-magic resonance array that vibrates directly through your teeth, rattles your jawbone, and makes your chest cavity feel like it is collapsing under immense atmospheric pressure. Your gold scar is weeping a freezing, luminescent dark violet fluid that smokes as it eats away at your skin. Inside your skull, the predatory Aurum Worm parasite is thrashing in total panic, screeching an unholy telepathic frequency that demands immediate, absolute planetary slaughter to protect its host. You stand alone on the grand marble stairs, staring down the barrels of an entire army, forced to wield your free will to either submit to their chains or paint the city grid in liquid gold wealth-magic.
start.name: Commander

choices.text: 🏃‍♂️ [MARTYRDOM] Voluntarily deactivate your protective gold shroud, dropping your hands to surrender to protect the helpless civilian hostages pinned behind the military barricades
🔥 [TOTAL BRUTALITY] Yield your physical body entirely to the chaotic madness of the parasite, unleashing an apocalyptic, city-wide gold storm that vaporizes the entire boulevard
🧠 [PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE] Plunge your fingers into the street's central mainframe terminal, forcing their communication networks to broadcast the agonizing screams of the gods you slaughtered

heroic_surrender_loop.text: You actively choose to resist the terrifying commands of the parasite, forcing your jaws shut as you exert your human free will to suppress the roaring, destructive hunger of your gold scar. The internal friction is pure agony; your gold tracking marks glow white-hot as thick, smoking dark blood streams down your neck, draining your physical stamina and dropping your survival pool significantly. You step down the marble stairs with your palms completely open, kneeling directly into the freezing puddles of rain on the boulevard. A specialized tactical vanguard squad of enforcers rushes forward through the searchlights, brutally slamming a magnetized, heavy stasis collar around your throat and clamping crushing runic cuffs onto your wrists. The anti-magic dampening voltage surges violently through your nervous system, causing your muscles to intensely seize and tear as your remaining health bar drops down to a razor-thin single digit. Through the blinding white sparks and somatic torment, you look past the armored hulls of the tanks and see thousands of lower-district citizens watching your sacrifice from the shadows of the alleyways. Because you chose to endure this torture instead of slaughtering the street, the public realizes the Ministry's tracking matrix can be resisted. The impoverished crowds break past the fences, launching a massive, chaotic civilian rebellion against the guards as they chant your name like an echo of freedom. You are forcefully thrown into the back of an armored containment transport, half-dead and bleeding metallic dust, but permanently cemented as an immortal folk savior.
heroic_surrender_loop.name: System

choices.text: ⏩ Maintain a fading grip on your consciousness as the heavy transport speeds directly into the roaring divine lightning storm

apocalyptic_gold_storm.text: A terrifying, deep laughter tears out of your throat as your human sanity splinters completely under the weight of the cosmic entity. You abandon all mercy, giving the predatory Aurum Worm total ownership of your neural network. Your gold scar violently ruptures outward across your face, ripping through skin and muscle tissue to expose an iridescent, pulsing dark violet chitinous carapace beneath. You slam both palms into the wet pavement, casting a colossal, hyper-pressurized kinetic shockwave of raw wealth-magic that sweeps down the three-mile boulevard at supersonic speeds. The sensory horror is absolute. You watch without blinking as tens of thousands of armored military vehicles, heavy tactical artillery tanks, and screaming enforcers are instantaneously calcified from the inside out. The iron in their bloodstreams and the synthetic polymers in their ceramic gear instantly liquefy and transmute into boiling, white-hot molten gold bullion that melts through bone and muscle. The concrete buildings on both sides of the avenue buckle and dissolve, their foundations transforming into a shimmering, agonizing river of gold sludge, superheated glass, and floating bone ash. The air turns a poisonous shade of dark purple, thick with the suffocating smell of vaporized ozone and incinerated flesh. You stand perfectly still at the center of a silent planetary graveyard of weeping, twisted gold statues, your health fully restored by the harvested lifeforce of the dead. You are no longer a wizard defending his freedom; you have evolved into a terrifying, cosmic monster of absolute, ruthless greed.
apocalyptic_gold_storm.name: Musa

choices.text: ⏩ March over the smoking hills of melted golden bodies to face the ancient divine pantheons descending through the clouds

psychological_broadcast.text: Refusing to yield to simple physical slaughter or weak submission, you utilize a precise, tactical application of your out-of-control power. You plunge your glowing, gold-veined fingers straight through the armored steel casing of a shattered street terminal on the curb, routing your scar's unique frequency directly into the Ministry's secure satellite communications grid. The parasitic worm inside your brain stem acts as a massive psychic amplifier, forcing every tactical military headset, armored vehicle radio, public emergency speaker, and digital billboard in the entire metropolitan layout to broadcast a raw, unedited loop of pure psychological horror. The atmosphere fills with the deafening, multi-layered telepathic screaming and agonizing death rattles of Albus Kojo, the eternal weeping of the fallen vault kings, and the mocking, hollow laughter of Hades from the underworld abyss. Thousands of elite enforcers instantly drop their assault rifles, clawing at their helmets and screaming in pure terror as their ears burst and stream blood from the sheer weight of the divine madness flooding their minds. Dozens of automated aerial defense drones lose their targeting code, glitching violently before crashing into the buildings in massive bursts of oil and flame. You walk calmly down the center of the boulevard through the weeping, completely paralyzed ranks of the military blockade like a nightmare ghost, your vitals heavily strained by the massive feedback loop, but your path completely cleared.
psychological_broadcast.name: Narrator

choices.text: ⏩ Stride past the shattered remnants of the frontline army as the upper atmosphere begins to tear open into cosmic anomalies

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
